project_type: React SPA (Vite + Tailwind) - single-file mind map / workflow canvas app
build_system: Vite with Tailwind CSS, no tests
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` to validate no compilation errors. Manual visual verification in browser.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node 22 available via nvm.
contribution_requirements: Single branch feat/redesign-cards-v2 already exists and is checked out.
key_patterns: Single App.jsx file (4634 lines) contains all logic. THEMES object defines color schemes. Nodes are {id, x, y, title, content, theme, groupId, cloneSourceId}. Groups are {id, name, x, y, width, height, expanded, theme, parentGroupId}. Canvas uses pointer events for pan/drag/resize. MiniMap.jsx is a separate component. computeLayout() auto-adjusts group sizes. updateActiveWorkspace() is the main state updater pattern.
directory_structure: src/App.jsx (main app), src/MiniMap.jsx (mini map component), src/index.css (styles), src/main.jsx (entry). package.json uses react, react-dom, lucide-react.
